register.labelZh: JOIN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: join in 可以幫助你接受邀請,以及描述參與遊戲、唱歌、討論和其他活動。；join up 可以描述朋友、旅客或隊伍在不同地方出發後會合。；join up 和 join something up 可以描述點、線、道路、小徑和不同部分連接起來。；join with somebody 可以表示人或團體一起感謝、歡迎、支持或幫助別人。
register.summaryEn: Join in helps you accept invitations and describe taking part in games, songs, discussions and other activities. Join up can describe friends, travellers or teams meeting after being in different places. Join up and join something up can describe dots, lines, roads, paths and separate pieces becoming connected. Join with somebody can show that people or groups act together to thank, welcome, support or help others.

fixedVariable.variableZh: join in 通常表示參與一項已經開始的活動。join up 可以表示分開的人會合,也可以表示分開的事物連接起來。；在 JOIN ... UP 中使用 it 或 them 時,把它放在 JOIN 和 UP 中間。；join with somebody 後面常接 in 和一項活動,例如 join with us in thanking the helpers。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Join in usually means taking part in an activity that is already happening. Join up can mean that separate people meet or that separate things connect. When using it or them in a JOIN...
